name: A fork run with its network closed
what: A fork can run with its network closed, for a check or a benchmark. Its record says whether the network stayed closed from the start of the run to its end, and holds each attempt that was denied. If the network was opened at any moment, the record shows when and who opened it, and does not say it stayed closed.

suggest.why: It costs little once a network can be closed, and it turns "the tests pass offline" into something the record shows.
